summary: @or-sdk/qna preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases page, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB sibling file shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated: a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header followed by a shuffled string-array decoder (WV8StW rotates array n7gIxM; hc1jfK9 decodes indices over a custom base-N alphabet) that reconstructs strings at runtime. No plaintext URLs, credentials, or API references are recoverable. The alternate runtime is used specifically to execute code that Node-based scanners will not resolve, at install time before any user interaction. The package is documented as a QnA SDK and has no legitimate reason to fetch a second JavaScript runtime and use it to run opaque obfuscated code on the installer's host at install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
